package rulefixtures

// scenario for go_perf_layer_data_structure_choice_small_enum_string_switch_map: Layer: Data structure choice. Flag map lookups for tiny static enum-like string sets where switch can avoid allocation and hashing.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: contextual.
type scenario523Operation int

const (
	scenario523Create scenario523Operation = iota
	scenario523Read
	scenario523Update
	scenario523Delete
)

var scenario523Handlers = map[scenario523Operation]func() string{
	scenario523Create: func() string { return "creating" },
	scenario523Read:   func() string { return "reading" },
	scenario523Update: func() string { return "updating" },
	scenario523Delete: func() string { return "deleting" },
}

func scenario523Positive(op scenario523Operation) string {
	if h, ok := scenario523Handlers[op]; ok {
		return h()
	}
	return "unknown"
}
